Step: 01-28-1598 + 11 weeks = 01-28-1598 + 77 days = 04-15-1598?  
Check: Jan 28 + 3 days → Jan 31 (3 days left in Jan).  
Feb 1598: 28 days (not leap year, 1598 not divisible by 4).  
March: 31 days.  
Days total: 3 (Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) = 62 days → Apr 1 is 63rd day.  
77 days total: 77 - 62 = 15 → April 15, 1598.  
Then add 2 more days → April 17, 1598.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1598-04-17
